'''Docking Bay 238''' was a docking bay on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. It was used as a rendezvous for members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].
